recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition featuring a central square photograph of a group in 1970s attire with a vintage car, framed by a wide white border, topped by a geometric Art Deco logo and anchored by bold, serifed title text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized vertical alignment of all elements
High-contrast black and white graphic elements vs. grainy color photography
Geometric logo structure mirroring the organic poses of the subjects
Generous white space acting as a structural frame
coreInvariants: Black ink for all graphic and typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is a medium-wide shot centered horizontally, occupying roughly 50% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The Art Deco logo at the top center serves as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan: Logo to central photograph to bottom title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white margins on all four sides, creating a clean, gallery-like presentation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Desaturated Earth Tones (Within the photograph: browns, creams, and muted blues)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white page and black graphics; low saturation within the central image to evoke a vintage film look.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly black and white for non-photographic elements

letterConstructionRules: Logo uses varying stroke weights and geometric integration (circles and rectangles)
Bottom text uses high-contrast thick-and-thin strokes with rounded serifs
Italicized stance for the bottom title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Logo characters are nested and overlapping within a rectangular grid
Sunburst graphic integrated into the logo base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric architectural display paired with a soft, heavy humanist serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and rounded serif style of the bottom text.
Captures the geometric Art Deco spirit for the logo construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph with a 1970s film grain aesthetic. The scene should feature a group of men in vintage suits and hats standing next to a classic 1930s-style luxury car. Place this square image in the center of a large, vertical white canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black Art Deco geometric logo at the top center featuring interlocking letters and a sunburst motif. Add a line of bold, italicized, rounded serif text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a perfect square?
Is the background pure white without texture?
Are all text elements centered horizontally?
Does the bottom text have a heavy, rounded serif appearance?

adjustableVariables: Subject matter of the central photo
Specific geometric patterns in the logo
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title text
Specific faces of people in the photo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the photo looks like a physical print pasted onto a white board.
Check that the logo does not touch the photo edge.
Verify the bottom text is italicized.
Confirm the car in the photo is vintage (pre-1950s style).
recipe.reuseFormula: Square vintage photo + White border frame + Art Deco header + Heavy serif footer = 70s Soul Aesthetic.
